methodology: Independent zero-trust re-validation. Every claim challenged. No prior reports trusted.

business_readiness.detail: Core flows work. Missing password reset, email verification, billing. Strong foundation for controlled launch.

product_completeness.detail: Planner, AI hints, auth, monitoring all functional. Reports and notifications missing. 14/23 pages live.

user_experience.detail: Functional but not polished. 9 pages use static data. No onboarding flow. No i18n.

security_posture.detail: 2 P0 vulns found and fixed. 1 P1 documented (rate limit bypass). JWT auth, RBAC, tenant isolation, CORS all active.

architecture_quality.detail: Microservice isolation is good. Gateway proxy bug fixed. In-memory state prevents HA. Test coverage is critical gap.

operations_maturity.detail: Monitoring/alerting good. Backups missing. Recovery validated. Single DB SPOF. Startup-level maturity.

scalability_realism.detail: Functional for <1k users. In-memory state, single DB, no horizontal scaling prevent 5k+. Previous claims of 10k+ are unrealistic without significant rework.

reliability.detail: Service restart recovery <10s. Circuit breakers active. Graceful shutdown. No automated DR tested.

maintainability.detail: Good isolation of shared modules. Only 2 test files. No CI/CD pipeline verified (Docker blocked).

deployment_readiness.detail: Manual deployment validated. K8s manifests exist. Docker compose defined. Docker Desktop blocked (Windows).

adjustment_reasons: Test coverage gap (2 test files vs industry standard)
No automated backups or disaster recovery
Stack traces exposed in development mode
verdict: SOLID MVP READY FOR CONTROLLED PRODUCTION LAUNCH. NOT world-class. NOT 10/10. Realistic score: 7.0/10 with 2-4 weeks of P0/P1 work needed for GA readiness.
